title: getTasksByPriority has duplicated logic across all three priority levels
description: The getTasksByPriority function in taskController.ts contains ~70 lines of copy-pasted code that repeats the exact same filter + sort logic three times for 'high', 'medium', and 'low' priority levels. This should be refactored into a single generic filter + sort using Array.filter() and Array.sort(). The fix requires rewriting the entire function and removing all the manual loop-based sorting. Estimated change: 65+ lines replaced.
